editor.saveContractAriaLabel: Auto backup and final save state
editor.diskContractNeedsSave: not on disk · click Save or press ⌘S
editor.validateContractClean: after saving, run folder check or folder validate
editor.validateContractDirty: before save: verification still reads disk
editor.revertContractClean: confirm before closing · git diff can recover
editor.previewTooltip: Show the result next to what you type
editor.saveConflict: This file changed on disk before the save completed. Your edits are kept. Copy them, refresh, then apply them to the latest file.
editor.saveIdentityUid: This line (uid) is the permanent id that keeps the document recognizable even after a rename, so it cannot be removed or changed. Restore the uid line and the save will go through.
editor.saveIdentityHistory: This line (merged_uids) records the documents merged into this one, so it cannot be edited here. Restore that line and the save will go through.
editor.discardConfirm: Discard unsaved changes and close the editor?
editor.mentionRelationFooter: Saved as a relation in the info block at the top, and a link goes into the text
editor.mentionEmpty: Nothing by that name in this folder
editor.mentionRelationAdded: Relation added: it shows on the map

palette.inputAriaLabel: Search, command or tag in Ontology documents
palette.noBodySearchTitle: Not found anywhere in your docs
palette.noBodySearchHint: Titles, summaries, tags, and full body text were all searched. Try a different word or a shorter phrase.
palette.noTitleSearchHint: Titles, summaries and tags were searched. Try a different word or a shorter phrase.
palette.noIndexingSearchHint: Titles, summaries, tags and the text of the documents indexed so far were searched. Try again when indexing finishes, or try a different word.
palette.noPartialSearchHint: Titles, summaries, tags and the text of every document the app reads were searched. Try a different word or a shorter phrase.

indexStatus.preparing: Getting ready to search inside every document. Titles, summaries and tags meanwhile.
indexStatus.building: Indexing <count>{indexed, number}</count> of {total, number} documents. Showing what is indexed so far.
indexStatus.partial: Searching inside {indexed, number} documents. The rest of this folder is past the app's limit of 100,000 files or 12 folder levels and is not searched.
indexStatus.off: Titles, summaries and tags only. The search index is off in Settings › Privacy · data.
indexStatus.paused: Titles, summaries and tags only. The search index was deleted; it is rebuilt when you open this folder again.
indexStatus.unavailable: Titles, summaries and tags only. The search index could not be opened on this computer.
indexStatus.unreadable: Titles, summaries and tags only. This folder could not be read to build the search index.

meta.notOnMapWikiBody: This is a wiki page about sources, so it is not on the map. That is expected: the map holds concepts, and a page like this is read in the Library beside its source.
meta.recordTimeTitle: Last written {at}. That is when the file changed, which is not the same as when someone checked it.
meta.revisionTitle: {count, plural, one {# commit has} other {# commits have}} changed this document. Git keeps the count; nobody edits it.
